column1: # Hand-checked words: word<TAB>IPA, loaded over lexicon.tsv (an entry here wins); a word#v line is the before-a-vowel form.
# 17 Nov: common words read with the less usual stress or a wrong suffix/guess (details = DEE-tails, sometimes = SOME-times, ...); sweep of the 5,000 most common words + forms
# 17 Nov: words outside the word list that the g2p model guessed wrong (barcode came out 'barcodey'): compounds and British spellings from the 40,000-word sweep
# 17 Nov: pron-sweep (evals/own-voice/open-release/evals/pron-sweep): clear errors found by checking every word (judge + second source, A/B-confirmed)
# 17 Nov: names and words from Kale's published cards, back from the internal list; each key's source and kind in override-sources.public.tsv (no card text)
# 19 Nov: weekdays end in "-deɪ" (the word list's first readings ended most in "-di"); 24 Nov: Monday uses secondary stress "-dˌeɪ" like Sunday (not "mˈʌn dˌi").
# 21 Nov: sunday secondary stress (d03 sunday->someday fix) and vetted pronunciation entries
# 22 Nov: restore vetted overrides (Elizabeth canary, Spanish j in Jurado, proper nouns)
